name: l2_scn_0903_the_war_nobody_names_v1
about: L2 scenario seed SCN-0903 (The War Nobody Names) overlaid on an Orion Station watch. A society has high-impact bonded combat capability, but public culture insists conflict is 'sport' or 'crime.' Veterans, scars, and doctrine exist at the margins. A triggering incident forces the truth into daylight. The seed is a pressure field and initial-condition template: roles, pressure axes, and knobs shape the run; expected end states are observation categories, never required endings. Root fixture only; not canon.
